Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He freezes on the spot, as if you somehow managed to cast a spell on him. His brow quirks momentarily, but whatever that was supposed to signify, it fades away when he gives into utter incredulousness.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: You do understand that him saying that does not mean that it reflects la réalité, oui ? It is like-- like--

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Gah ! You are not convinced. He wormed deep into votre cerveau and is not letting go. What can I do to ..?

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: His hands fly out to either side, and slap against his hips in their return. An agonized expression settles down on his face.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Fine ! There is no use denying it anymore.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: I am indeed ... not as French as I want to be. But tell me : if you were to grow up in the Outlands, and you do not identify with whatever became of that cult, would you not want to pretend that you are un humain normal instead ?

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: Non, do not even answer that. I am sure that you are tempted to preach about how it is not the same thing, or that I cannot simply choose to be what I am. I do not wish to hear it.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: The life I sprouted into was épouvantable ! Completely ! It is bad enough that you denied me the little joy I had in living like someone better.

Entries.Name: Canuck Kweebec
Entries.Line: And it is not like I am not French at all. All I have showed you is real, and experienced, and--

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: He draws in an audible breath, which appears to calm him down at least somewhat. But after a single blink, his entire expression collapses into that of all-encompassing shame, and his body shakes like it's ready to bolt out of here.

Entries.Name: Narrator
Entries.Line: In the end, that's what he does. Well, not before mumbling something out -- sans his theatrical accent.
